intro: Burundi is a landlocked land of green hills on the shore of Lake Tanganyika.

chapters.title: Land
text: Lake Tanganyika, one of the world's deepest lakes, borders the west. Hills cover most of the country. The southernmost source of the Nile is claimed to be in Burundi.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The climate is mild in the highlands, with two rainy seasons.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Burundi's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
